USA Formations - By State

This page will allow you to view USA crop circle formation reports by the state in which the crop circle formations were reported. For each state that has had a crop circle formation reported, the number of crop circle formations reported in that state is also noted in parenthesis (#x) next to the state located in the state list below.

Director's Note: If any reader while in the course of reading any particular crop circle formation report, knows of any additional information about that given report, has additional photos, analysis, or information that they would like to have included in the report listing, or sees any factual errors that need correcting - - or you don't see a report that should be listed -- please contact us -- these report listings are intended to be a compendium of all the information about any one report that the crop circle research community has been able to collect. All contribuitons will be acknowledged and sourced. These pages will be a continuous work in progress.

** Under Construction, please keep checking back. If you see no change - hit your refresh button.
